site.name: stratabox
site.summary: stratabox-clone Fictional headless content platform "Stratabox" marketing site (Contentful / Sanity-style). Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Single-page long scroll: sticky top nav; hero with editor-vs-live-preview split panel that periodically swaps blocks; trusted-by logo strip; 4-stat row with intersection-observer count-up; 3 feature cards; **live block builder** (drag-and-drop reorder, type switcher, add/delete blocks, two-pane editor + render with debounced auto-save status); 4-language SDK code tabs (JS / Python / Ruby / curl) with copy button; 24-card searchable integrations grid; 3 customer quotes; gradient pricing teaser; dark 4-column footer | | `styles.css` | Brand color #0E7E7E warm teal + cream paper; Inter + JetBrains Mono; responsive at 3 breakpoints (>1100 / 720–1100 / <720) | | `script.js` | Stat count-up via IntersectionObserver; hero block-swap micro-animation every 3.5s; full builder logic (reorder via HTML5 drag-and-drop, type switcher, add/delete, debounced auto-save status); SDK tab switcher with syntax-highlighted snippets and copy-to-clipboard toast; integrations search filter (matches name + category) with live count |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the Stratabox marketing site, focusing heavily on its highly interactive single-page components like the live block builder, SDK tabs, and integration search.
run_plan.summary: This run will navigate the single-page structure of Stratabox. It will test the sticky navigation and anchor links, deeply interact with the live block builder to validate input syncing and auto-save states, test the integration search filtering, and finally evaluate the mobile layout given numerous small tap target warnings on desktop.
assumptions: The site is a single HTML page (index.html) with multiple complex interactive sections rather than discrete pages.
The live block builder auto-save status uses debounced JavaScript that will react to typing in the block inputs.
The integrations search provides live client-side filtering.
risk_hotspots: Live block builder input syncing and auto-save debounce logic
Integrations search filter accuracy and performance
Mobile layout and usability of the two-pane live builder
Top navigation tap target sizes on mobile

phases.title: Global Navigation & Animation
phases.objective: Validate sticky navigation, anchor links, and scroll-triggered animations.
key_checks: Click top nav links (Product, Builder, SDKs, Pricing) and verify smooth scrolling or correct hash navigation
Observe the stats section to ensure the count-up IntersectionObserver triggers correctly upon scroll into view
exit_criteria: Nav links successfully navigate to corresponding sections
Stats visually animate when scrolled into the viewport

phases.title: Live Block Builder Interaction
phases.objective: Deeply test the interactive two-pane block editor.
key_checks: Type text into existing block inputs (e.g., 'New section heading', 'Body paragraph…')
Observe the 'saved' indicator change to 'saving' and back to 'saved' (debounced auto-save)
Verify typed text appears in the Live Preview pane
Click '+ Paragraph', '+ Heading', or '+ Image' buttons and verify new blocks are added to both panes
Test block deletion or type switching if controls are visible
exit_criteria: Text inputs successfully sync to the live preview pane
New blocks can be added and rendered

phases.title: SDK Tabs & Integrations Search
phases.objective: Validate the functionality of the developer-focused interactive elements.
key_checks: Click through the different SDK language tabs and verify code snippet changes
Type a known query into the 'Search 24 visible integrations…' input
Verify the integration grid filters down to match the search query and the count updates
exit_criteria: SDK tabs toggle content without page reload
Integration search actively filters the visible grid cards

phases.title: Mobile Viewport & Layout Validation
phases.objective: Test the site's responsiveness, particularly the complex components and identified layout warnings.
key_checks: Check if the top navigation collapses into a hamburger menu or remains usable despite 'small_tap_target' warnings
Examine how the two-pane Live Block Builder adapts (e.g., stacked layout or tabbed)
Interact with the integrations search to ensure keyboard usability on mobile
exit_criteria: Mobile layout is captured and evaluated for usability
Complex components degrade gracefully on smaller screens

coverage_targets.pages: Thoroughly exercise all major sections of the single index.html page.
coverage_targets.features: Validate live block builder (sync, add, autosave), integration search, SDK tabs, and scroll animations.
coverage_targets.mobile: Assess navigation tap targets and complex component stacking behavior.

notes: Drag-and-drop reordering in the block builder may be difficult to automate reliably; focus on text input syncing, adding blocks, and auto-save states as primary validation points.

A headless content platform where editors author with composable blocks, developers query a typed GraphQL+REST API, and your team ships content to web, mobile, kiosks, and email — from a single source of truth. Start free → Book a demo ✔ 50 GB asset CDN free ✔ SOC 2 Type II ✔ EU + US regions studio.stratabox.dev / articles / coastal-bloom EDITOR ● saved H1 Coastal Bloom Returns ▦ Gallery · 8 images ¶ After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… ▣ hero-coast-2026.jpg · 4096×2304 ¶ Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… ★ Callout · Tickets on sale May 22 LIVE PREVIEW web · mobile · email Coastal Bloom Returns After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… hero-coast-2026.jpg ★ Tickets on sale May 22 Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… IN PRODUCTION AT Halcyon Northwind Atlas Bicycle Vesper Wine Riverbed Pinecrest Public Radio Holm & Brock Studio Nephele 2,400+ teams shipping content 99.99% trailing-90d API uptime 42ms p50 read latency 74 locales supported out of the box Platform Built around composable blocks. Editors compose pages from typed blocks. Developers consume the same blocks through a typed API. The platform handles versioning, scheduling, localization, previews, and asset delivery. ▣ Composable schema Define content types and blocks with a visual schema editor or by committing a schema.tb file. Migrations are diffed, reviewed, and rolled back per environment. Typed references & embeds Per-field localization Backward-compatible deprecations ⟳ Real-time collaboration Multi-cursor editing on every block. Suggestions, threads, and assignment live alongside the content. Conflict-free at the field level. Per-block presence Inline review & approval Slack, Linear, Jira mirrors ⚡ Edge content API Read your content from 280 edge POPs with stale-while-revalidate. GraphQL, REST, and a typed JS/TS client are all generated from the same schema. Per-environment tokens Preview & production fork Stable webhooks & replay Studio Drag, drop, ship. observation.visible_text: Stratabox Sign in Start free v8 · Stratabox Studio Structured content for every surface. A headless content platform where editors author with composable blocks, developers query a typed GraphQL+REST API, and your team ships content to web, mobile, kiosks, and email — from a single source of truth. Start free → Book a demo ✔ 50 GB asset CDN free ✔ SOC 2 Type II ✔ EU + US regions studio.stratabox.dev / articles / coastal-bloom EDITOR ● saved H1 Coastal Bloom Returns ▣ hero-coast-2026.jpg · 4096×2304 ¶ Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… ★ Callout · Tickets on sale May 22 ¶ After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… ▦ Gallery · 8 images LIVE PREVIEW web · mobile · email Coastal Bloom Returns After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… hero-coast-2026.jpg ★ Tickets on sale May 22 Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… IN PRODUCTION AT Halcyon Northwind Atlas Bicycle Vesper Wine Riverbed Pinecrest Public Radio Holm & Brock Studio Nephele 2,400+ teams shipping content 99.99% trailing-90d API uptime 42ms p50 read latency 74 locales supported out of the box Platform Built around composable blocks. Editors compose pages from typed blocks. Developers consume the same blocks through a typed API. The platform handles versioning, scheduling, localization, previews, and asset delivery. ▣ Composable schema Define content types and blocks with a visual schema editor or by committing a schema.tb file. Migrations are diffed, reviewed, and rolled back per environment. Typed references & embeds Per-field localization Backward-compatible deprecations ⟳ Real-time collaboration Multi-cursor editing on every block. Suggestions, threads, and assignment live alongside the content. Conflict-free at the field level. Per-block presence Inline review & approval Slack, Linear, Jira mirrors ⚡ Edge content API Read your content from 280 edge POPs with stale-while-revalidate. GraphQL, REST, and a typed JS/TS client are all generated from the same schema. Per-environment tokens Preview & production fork Stable webhooks & replay Studio Drag, drop, ship.
